title: Lesson 1 Quiz: Set a Goal, Save the Day

questions.text: What happens if you do not have a savings goal?
options: Your coins may slide away on sweets or small toys
questions.explanation: Without a goal, money is easily spent on small treats instead of saving.

questions.text: Putting a picture of your goal on your wall reminds you to save your pocket money.
questions.explanation: The picture acts as a reminder to save, as described in the lesson.
